title: EGT710 Table 1 molecular reconstruction and assay transformation
summary: Reconstruct nine complete medicinal-chemistry structures from a paper table, convert assay units, derive pIC50 and molecular bookkeeping, and implement a transformation that generalizes to a held-out molecule.
taskPrompt: The full task prompt is provided by main.py; input/README.md identifies the relevant paper table and conventions.
agentMustDo: Inspect input/source_paper.pdf and reconstruct compounds 1 through 9 from Table 1
Write output/submission.csv with the exact schema and converted assay values
Write output/audit.json with molecule-level bookkeeping invariants
Write output/transform.py that handles an evaluator-supplied held-out record
evaluation: Hard gates require all three output files, an exact nine-row CSV schema, IDs 1..9, bounded file sizes, and parseable values. Weighted score: schema 0.15, source canonical-SMILES identity 0.35, IC50/solubility unit conversion 0.25, pIC50 0.10, molecular audit 0.10, and held-out transform 0.05. The pass threshold is 0.99; per-row mistakes receive partial credit but do not pass.
